never_cover.rule: Primary operations involving hazardous materials storage, treatment, transport, or disposal
never_cover.description: Decline any applicant whose core business handles hazardous or toxic materials.  Such risks carry environmental and long-tail liabilities beyond the BOP program.

never_cover.rule: Sponsorship or operation of athletic teams or sporting events
never_cover.description: Decline accounts that organize, sponsor, or manage athletic teams or events, as these create high off-premises bodily-injury exposures outside standard coverage.

never_cover.rule: Use of subcontractors without Certificates of Insurance or hold-harmless agreements
never_cover.description: Decline submissions where subcontractors lack proof of insurance or risk-transfer contracts.  Absence of COIs leaves the insured exposed to vicarious liability.

never_cover.rule: Any principal or entity with fraud, arson, or similar criminal conviction
never_cover.description: Decline if background screening or public records reveal prior dishonest or intentional-loss offenses indicating moral hazard.

never_cover.rule: History of insurance policy cancellations, declinations, or non-renewals within three years
never_cover.description: Decline if prior carriers canceled or declined coverage for underwriting reasons.  Such history signals elevated risk or misrepresentation.

never_cover.rule: Provision of ambulance, emergency, or medical transport services
never_cover.description: Decline any risk engaged in patient or emergency transport; professional and auto exposures exceed BOP appetite.

never_cover.rule: Lack of legally required Workers’ Compensation coverage
never_cover.description: Decline applicants with employees but no active Workers’ Compensation policy or exemption.  Statutory non-compliance is uninsurable.

never_cover.rule: Operations involving cannabis, CBD, or other controlled substances
never_cover.description: Decline any business cultivating, manufacturing, or selling cannabis or controlled substances due to federal illegality and regulatory uncertainty.

never_cover.rule: Interrelated or commonly owned businesses creating uncontrolled exposure aggregation
never_cover.description: Decline when multiple entities share ownership or operations that materially expand exposure beyond one insured risk.

never_cover.rule: Manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products
never_cover.description: Decline applicants performing product manufacturing or alteration beyond incidental private labeling.  Such operations introduce products liability outside BOP scope.

never_cover.rule: Rental, loan, or leasing of equipment to others without contract or insurance transfer
never_cover.description: Decline if the insured rents or loans equipment without written agreements and COIs.  Uncontrolled transfer creates completed-operations exposure.

never_cover.rule: Unresolved bankruptcy, foreclosure, or serious financial distress
never_cover.description: Decline if the applicant is in active bankruptcy or has significant unpaid judgments or liens, indicating potential moral hazard or instability.

never_cover.rule: Significant exposure to flammables, explosives, or reactive chemicals
never_cover.description: Decline operations presenting inherent combustion or explosion hazards unless specifically filed and engineered within program tolerances.

never_cover.rule: Unmitigated catastrophe-prone property exposures (wind, flood, quake)
never_cover.description: Decline locations in catastrophe zones without appropriate mitigation or reinsurance capacity.  Verify program filings before quoting.

never_cover.rule: Prior or pending claims involving sexual misconduct, discrimination, or negligent hiring
never_cover.description: Decline applicants with substantiated SAM or discrimination claims.  Such allegations indicate unacceptable employment-practices risk.

never_cover.rule: Uncorrected fire or life-safety code violations
never_cover.description: Decline any property with open fire-code or life-safety violations at time of binding.  Require proof of correction and inspection clearance.
